Allowed origins (`worker/src/index.ts`, the `cors()` middleware's `origin` function, ~lines 20–30):

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that `origin` callback in `worker/src/index.ts` — add another condition (e.g. `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')`) inside the `if (...)` check before `return origin;`. Note: Hono's `origin` array form only does exact-string matches, so wildcard subdomains must stay in this function form. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md#4-cors` for background.
